messages:
sarah_auditor: Hi team — auditor here. Need a combined evidence package for a SOC2 follow-up: timeline of the recent incident (2025-02-12), RBAC changes that week, KMS key access logs, and vuln-triage notes. Auditor wants a stitch showing ‘who changed what’ + key decrypt events. Can you confirm where to pull artifacts and an expected ETA?

laura_sec_eng: thanks — noted. I can own the RBAC change proof and link the PRs.

mike_platform: I can pull KMS CloudTrail entries and the Splunk query for service-account usage. quick q: do auditors want raw logs or redacted extracts + checksums?

sarah_auditor: raw logs are ok but we prefer redacted for secrets. checksums for exported files please. also need mapping: PR => deploy => runbook step that triggered the role change.

laura_sec_eng: plan: 1) RBAC change PRs + approval history (GH) 2) k8s rolebinding manifest diff + who applied (kubectl events) 3) deploy timeline from CI 4) runbook reference. ETA EOD tomorrow.

jordan_sre: I'll attach the incident response timeline from pagerduty + the postmortem pointer. pd incident: PD-4879 opened 2025-02-12T03:12Z, mitigation at 2025-02-12T03:46Z.

mike_platform: Splunk query to get KMS access (shared for reproducibility):
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey userIdentity.type=\"AssumedRole\" \"kms:keyId\"=\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345\" | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters
```

mike_platform: export process: run above in Splunk range 2025-02-12T00:00:00 to 2025-02-13T00:00:00, save as CSV, gzip, compute sha256. I'll upload to s3://redwood-audit-exports/2025-02/kms-decrypts-1829999999.csv.gz

laura_sec_eng: RBAC artifacts: GH PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8124 (rbac change) and /pull/8130 (hotfix). Approvals: 2 approvals from @laura_sec_eng and @mike_platform, timestamped in GH audit log. Kubernetes apply recorded via `kubectl apply --record` in CI.

jordan_sre: runbook steps referenced: docs/runbooks/incident-2025-02-12.md (line refs included). Postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/PD-4879-draft

laura_sec_eng: vuln triage notes: CVE-2025-XXXX applied to component `token-service` — patch PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-service/pull/129, patch deployed 2025-02-12T04:10Z. Triage doc snippet: \"Exploitability low, immediate mitigation applied: rotate keys, restrict role binding, update WAF rule.\"

mike_platform: KMS metadata: key alias = alias/ci-encrypt, key id = abcd-ef01-2345, rotation enabled, AmazonKMS key policy includes admins + ops role. CloudTrail bucket: s3://redwood-cloudtrail-logs/prod/2025/02/12/.

sarah_auditor: perfect — can you also include a CSV mapping file with columns: artifact_name, artifact_path, sha256, produced_by, produced_at? auditor prefers a simple manifest.

evidence-bot: Packaging run started. Step 1: collect artifacts per manifest. Step 2: redact PII/secrets. Step 3: compute checksums. Upload destination: s3://redwood-auditor-delivery/sarah_auditor/1829999999-evidence.tar.gz (presigned link TTL 7d).

laura_sec_eng: I will produce the manifest. Sample row I'll include: `rbac_pr_8124, https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8124, <sha256>, laura_sec_eng, 2025-02-12T05:02Z`

mike_platform: FYI — Splunk export and CloudTrail archive will be stored under a single folder: s3://redwood-auditor-delivery/1829999999/raw-logs/; checksums in manifest.

jordan_sre: ETA: I'll drop the PD timeline + runbook excerpt by 1830000000 (about ~10m).

laura_sec_eng: I'll assemble PR diffs, approval history, and artifact manifest by EOD tomorrow. If auditor needs immediate sample, I can push a redacted package by EOD today.

sarah_auditor: redacted sample today would be great. final ask: include a short README in the package that explains redaction rules and the mapping between PR/run/deploy timestamps. thanks all :thumbsup:

mike_platform: noted — will include README and scripts we used to compute exports (no credentials).

evidence-bot: Packaging complete (redacted sample). Uploaded to s3://redwood-auditor-delivery/sarah_auditor/sample-1829999999.tar.gz, sha256: 3b7f1c2a9d... . Full package pending final approvals.
